summary.text: Tony Isa is a Republican member of the Indiana House of Representatives who represents District 51, assumed office on November 6, 2024, and is the incumbent in the November 3, 2026 general election for that seat.
Ballotpedia lists Judy Rowe (D) as the other candidate on the general election ballot.

paragraphs.text: Tony Isa's career experience includes being a small business owner and real estate agent.
Isa succeeded Dennis Zent (R) in District 51.
For 2025-2026, Ballotpedia lists her on the Agriculture and Rural Development, Employment, Labor and Pensions, and Public Health committees.
